verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Automations can run Copilot cloud agent on a schedule or in response to repository events such as an issue being opened (docs-15, docs-33). The cloud agent then works independently in the background to plan and execute tasks (docs-31, docs-3), and Autofix adds vulnerability-fix suggestions (docs-13). Together these cover triggered, autonomous maintenance and fixing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled or triggered automations work in practice, and deeper docs on configuring automations and their triggers (the evidence is only one-line mentions).
